turns.question: Do we sell more at weekends? Between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026, what was our average daily revenue on Saturdays and Sundays, and on the other days?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric, so I cannot give a weekend-versus-other-days daily average; the closest metric is Revenue (EUR), which for 17 August to 27 September 2026 (six of each weekday) came to EUR 2,252.75 on Saturdays, EUR 2,423.75 on Sundays, and on the other days EUR 2,340.75 (Mon), 2,301.25 (Tue), 2,329.25 (Wed), 2,383.25 (Thu) and 2,221.75 (Fri), so Sunday is the highest day but Saturday is below most weekdays. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
